name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
description: Vertex is a profitable biotech that is, in practice, a cystic fibrosis (CF) drug company. Its CF medicines (TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO and the newer ALYFTREK) are taken daily as pills for life by patients and generated about 98 percent of FY2025 revenue of $12.0 billion, with no real competitor in CF. Growth now comes from launches in other areas: CASGEVY (a gene-editing cure for sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia, sold in partnership with CRISPR Therapeutics) and JOURNAVX (a non-opioid pain pill, launched 2025) are still small, and povetacicept for IgA nephropathy has an FDA decision date of 2026-11-30. FY2025 net income was $3.95 billion against a $536M loss in 2024, which carried a $4.6B acquired in-process R&D charge.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code is 2834 (Pharmaceutical Preparations), from the EDGAR submissions record.

businessLines.name: Cystic fibrosis: TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO
businessLines.how: Chronic daily pill for the life of the patient, paid by insurers and governments at list prices negotiated country by country; revenue is patients on therapy times net price, growing through new approvals in younger patients and new countries.
businessLines.description: Triple-combination CF pill, the mature core product.

businessLines.name: Cystic fibrosis: ALYFTREK
businessLines.how: Same lifelong-pill model as TRIKAFTA, priced similarly; largely converts existing TRIKAFTA patients, so it partly replaces rather than adds revenue.
businessLines.description: Next-generation once-daily CF pill launched in 2025.

businessLines.name: Other CF products
businessLines.how: Chronic daily pills for CF patients not on the newer regimens.

revenue.note: Computed: Other product revenues 820.1 minus CASGEVY 115.8 and JOURNAVX 59.6 (the 10-K says Other product revenues included those two)

businessLines.revenueNote: Computed: Other product revenues 820.1 minus CASGEVY 115.8 and JOURNAVX 59.6 (the 10-K says Other product revenues included those two)

businessLines.name: CASGEVY (sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia)
businessLines.how: Single treatment per patient at a very high price, paid by insurers and health systems after a long process of cell collection, treatment centre onboarding and manufacturing; revenue recognised when the patient is infused, so it lags patient starts.

businessLines.name: JOURNAVX (acute pain)
businessLines.how: Short-course prescription for acute pain, paid per prescription by insurers; volume depends on formulary coverage and physician adoption.
businessLines.description: Non-opioid oral pain medicine launched in 2025.

brands.name: ALYFTREK
brands.share: 7.0% of FY2025 total revenues (Q2 2026: $573.6M, 17% of quarter revenue)

whatsNext.text: FDA decision (PDUFA target action date 2026-11-30) on povetacicept for adults with IgA nephropathy, which would launch Vertex's kidney franchise
